name: Beetaloo Energy Australia Limited
summary: Beetaloo Energy Australia Limited, together its subsidiaries, engages in the production and sale of oil and natural gas in Australia. The company holds a 100% working interest in approximately 28 million acres of exploration tenements located in the Beetaloo Sub-basin, Northern Territory, Australia. The company was formerly known as Empire Energy Group Limited and changed its name to Beetaloo Energy Australia Limited and changed its name to in June 2025. Beetaloo Energy Australia Limited was incorporated in 1981 and is headquartered in Sydney, Australia.
